prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I took that quick rail trip from Beijing over to Shanghai, and it still cracks me up how chaotic the station felt at rush hour.
I also remembered this Chengdu leg from that same year—everyone kept talking about how there were way more attractions than we could realistically squeeze in.
For the Beijing–Shanghai part, my coworker had already gotten me on train D321 for 2025-03-19, so I didn’t have to deal with any of the ticket stuff myself.
The ticket was under Feng Jie, and they’d picked First Class—honestly, that extra space saved me after a long week.
And in Chengdu, my friend said they’d already sorted the Giant Panda Base visit for 2025-05-27 in the afternoon—Emma Taylor’s name on it, and it was for 4 people.
